open_graph.og:title: Just-In-Time Compilation (JIT) - Glossary | MDN
open_graph.og:description: JIT (Just-In-Time Compilation) is a compilation process in which code is translated from an intermediate representation or a higher-level language (e.g., JavaScript or Java bytecode) into machine code at runtime, rather than prior to execution. This approach combines the benefits of both interpretation and ahead-of-time (AOT) compilation.
